requirements.title: Numeric intrinsics use processor numeric models
requirements.definition: Numeric manipulation and inquiry functions are described using numeric models whose parameters are chosen to best fit the executing processor.

pending.numeric-intrinsics-use-processor-models: Observe model parameters through DIGITS, RADIX, RANGE, HUGE, TINY, MINEXPONENT, MAXEXPONENT, PRECISION, or BIT_SIZE; do not hard-code hardware formats.
pending.model-parameters-best-fit-processor: Observe model parameters through DIGITS, RADIX, RANGE, HUGE, TINY, MINEXPONENT, MAXEXPONENT, PRECISION, or BIT_SIZE; do not hard-code hardware formats.

requirements.title: The integer model set is defined by radix r and digit count q
requirements.definition: The integer model set is determined by sign, radix r greater than one, positive q, digits in range 0..r-1, and parameters r and q.

pending.integer-model-radix-exceeds-one: Use RADIX and DIGITS on integer objects; assert r>1 and q>0 and use them to guard any exact integer range plan.

requirements.title: The real model set is defined by base, precision, exponent bounds, digits, sign, and zero conventions
requirements.definition: The real model set is zero or a signed normalized base-b significand with p digits and exponent between inclusive minimum and maximum bounds; b and p exceed one, fraction digits are in range with first nonzero for nonzero x, and zero has exponent and digits zero.

pending.real-base-and-precision-exceed-one: Use RADIX/DIGITS/MINEXPONENT/MAXEXPONENT and exact values such as 0.0 and 1.0; do not inspect hidden bits or require rounded approximations.
pending.real-fraction-digits-normalized: Use RADIX/DIGITS/MINEXPONENT/MAXEXPONENT and exact values such as 0.0 and 1.0; do not inspect hidden bits or require rounded approximations.
pending.real-exponent-inclusive-bounds: Use RADIX/DIGITS/MINEXPONENT/MAXEXPONENT and exact values such as 0.0 and 1.0; do not inspect hidden bits or require rounded approximations.
pending.real-zero-exponent-and-digits-zero: Use RADIX/DIGITS/MINEXPONENT/MAXEXPONENT and exact values such as 0.0 and 1.0; do not inspect hidden bits or require rounded approximations.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 16 general text, 16 through 16.8: intrinsic procedure classes and general rules, the bit and numeric models, atomic and collective subroutines, and the standard generic and specific name tables (batch178). This opens Clause 16. Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; round 1 found conditional pending plans for the atomic and collective STAT semantics, now resolved into explicit decisions: image-dependent facets are out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision, and the 'any other error' STAT values have no portable oracle because such an error cannot be induced portably. C1601 and C1602 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
